items.headline: Applied Digital signs 18-year, 150 MW lease with an investment-grade hyperscaler
items.summary: About $5.4B of base-term revenue (about $12.7B over 33 years with renewals), which works out to roughly $2.0M per MW a year or about $167 per kW-month; the company says pricing is higher than its prior leases. Financed through its $5B Macquarie equity partnership then project debt; delivery from 1H 2028; contracted base-term revenue now above $41B, about 75% investment grade.

items.headline: Nvidia cuts neocloud commitments to $32B and makes support conditional on completion
items.summary: Commitments under its neocloud agreements fell to $32B at end-October from $36B; Kress said they activate only after the neocloud has secured financing, deployed and had capacity accepted, none fall due before fiscal 2028, and a delayed project loses the guarantee. Construction risk stays with developers and their lenders.

items.headline: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO; neocloud stocks rebound
items.summary: On 23 Nov the board reversed Huang's 12 Nov resignation; Kress returns to CFO. Nvidia rose about 31%, Nebius about 23% and CoreWeave about 21% intraday. Goldman said it remains to be seen whether Nvidia will keep striking multi-party ecosystem deals at the same scale.

items.headline: Apollo and Goldman price about $44B of SpaceX GPU notes, upsized
items.summary: Senior and subordinated notes fund Nvidia Vera Rubin equipment for SpaceX's terrestrial compute, with deliveries and lease starts in 1H 2027; anchors include BlackRock, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and KKR-advised accounts. Called the largest GPU financing to date; pricing per tranche was not disclosed in the source read.

items.headline: CoreWeave default swaps near 1,233 bps; Apollo's Rowan warns of neocloud 'existential crisis'
items.summary: CoreWeave 5-year CDS rose as much as 76 bps to 1,232.6 on 20 Nov and its 9.75% 2031 bond yields close to 16%; Oracle CDS about 328 bps. Rowan said many neocloud projects lose access to capital without Nvidia as guarantor; Tuttle and Defiance filed for ETFs that buy CDS on CoreWeave, Oracle, Meta and a Mag 7 basket.

items.headline: Anthropic prices record IPO at $83, raising $81.3B
items.summary: 980 million shares at $83, above the $70 to $78 range, plus a $26B concurrent private placement; about $1.38T fully diluted at pricing, trading as ANT from 19 Nov. Gives the largest marginal compute buyer a much bigger cash cushion behind its leases.

items.headline: Trump threatens ban or 'tremendous tax' on US firms building AI data centers abroad
items.summary: Said at a 20 Nov White House press conference with no mechanism, size, company or country named, and before telling his own officials; Congress holds taxing power. Directly relevant to any US tenant for a non-US site. Reported widely (CNBC, AP, Axios); no policy text yet.

items.headline: Argentina country risk jumps 236 bps in a week to 1,070
items.summary: JP Morgan spread hit its highest since October 2025; Global bonds fell about 7% on the week, CCL reached $1,794 and the gap to the official rate widened to 13.6%. YPF fell 12.5%, Vista 9.4% and Pampa 5.4% in dollars; analysts cite the 2027 election and global risk-off.

items.headline: Pampa Energía incorporates Pampa AI for Vaca Muerta gas-powered data centers
items.summary: The new subsidiary, now in the Boletín Oficial, will use about 800 MW of Pampa generation and Vaca Muerta gas, starting at Loma La Lata in Neuquén; its bylaws allow data centers, GPU imports, IaaS and GPU-as-a-Service, and acting as a wholesale-market power agent. No investment amount or tenant has been announced.

kona: Debt got dearer on both of Kona's axes this week: Argentine country risk jumped to 1,070 bps (from about 830) while CoreWeave's default swaps hit about 1,233 bps and Nvidia said its neocloud support only switches on after a project is financed, built and accepted, so Kona cannot lean on vendor backstops during construction and should price any debt off an investment-grade tenant or lab guarantee, not its own credit. The offtake signal is better: Applied Digital signed an 18-year, 150 MW investment-grade lease at about $167 per kW-month with higher pricing than its earlier deals, which supports Kona's turnkey-lease pricing, but Trump's threatened ban or tax on US firms building data centers abroad is a new, undefined risk for any US hyperscaler or lab tenant in Neuquén. Pampa Energía has now incorporated Pampa AI with 800 MW and Vaca Muerta gas at Loma La Lata, a direct local competitor for the same tenants and a possible gas or power partner.

title: Credit tightens, Argentina reprices, Pampa enters Kona's lane
